Suffolk Bicycle Riders Association Club Rides

Centereach, NY · Road

Beginner friendly

Suffolk Bicycle Riders Association Club Rides is a road group ride in Centereach, NY. Schedule: Several rides every Saturday and Sunday, plus weekday rides most days. Each ride's time, start, distance and class (AA to D) is posted on the club's upcoming rides list; the club also runs mountain bike rides in winter, from Varies by ride (county parks, train stations and bike shops across Suffolk County); the club keeps a start-locations list. About 20–65 miles, classes AA (22+ mph) down to D (6–10 mph). C and D rides have a sweep and frequent stops..

For visitors

The club says its ride schedule is open to members and non-members. New riders usually start on a D ride. Bring a bike in good repair, a helmet, a spare tube or patch kit and water. The club meets at 7 pm on the first Thursday of the month in Centereach.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 6–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Suffolk Bicycle Riders Association Club Rides group ride

Long Island's biggest club posts several rides a day on its public list, from short, slow D rides to fast AA paceline rides. On Oct 1, 2026 the list had eight rides on Thursday alone. D rides are short, slow and made for beginners, and C and D rides are swept so nobody is left behind.
